arxiv-1804-06571.title: On the stab number of rectangle intersection graphs
arxiv-1804-06571.creator: Dibyayan Chakraborty, Mathew C. Francis
arxiv-1804-06571.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Dibyayan Chakraborty, Mathew C. Francis. We introduce the notion of stab number and exact stab number of rectangle intersection graphs, otherwise known as graphs of boxicity at most 2. A graph G G is said to be a k k -stabbable rectangle intersection graph , or k k -SRIG for short, if it has a rectangle intersection representation in which k k horizontal lines can be chosen such that each rectangle is intersected by at least one of them.

arxiv-2107-11262.title: Image-to-Image Translation with Low Resolution Conditioning
arxiv-2107-11262.creator: Mohamed Abid, Ihsen Hedhli, Jean-François Lalonde, Christian Gagne
arxiv-2107-11262.description: Abstract Most image-to-image translation methods focus on learning mappings across domains with the assumption that images share content (e.g., pose) but have their own domain-specific information known as style. When conditioned on a target image, such methods aim to extract the style of the target and combine it with the content of the source image.

arxiv-2212-03501.title: Eight times four bialgebras of hypergraphs, cointeractions, and chromatic polynomials
arxiv-2212-03501.creator: Kurusch Ebrahimi-Fard, Gunnar Fløystad
arxiv-2212-03501.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Kurusch Ebrahimi-Fard, Gunnar Fløystad. The bialgebra of hypergraphs, a generalization of W. Schmitt’s Hopf algebra of graphs [ 25 ] , is shown to have a cointeracting bialgebra, giving a double bialgebra in the sense of L. Foissy, who has recently proven [ 16 ] there is then a unique double bialgebra morphism to the double bialgebra structure on the polynomial ring ℚ ⁡ [ x ] {\mathbb{Q}}[x] . We show that the associated polynomial is the hypergraph chromatic polynomial.

arxiv-2303-14058.title: Newton’s methods for solving linear inverse problems with neural network coders 0 0 footnotetext: 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification : 65J22, 47J07 0 0 footnotetext: Keywords : Gauss-Newton’s method, inverse problems, neural networks
arxiv-2303-14058.creator: Otmar Scherzer otmar.scherzer@univie.ac.at, Bernd Hofmann hofmannb@mathematik.tu-chemnitz.de, Zuhair Nashed zuhair.nashed@ucf.edu
arxiv-2303-14058.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Otmar Scherzer otmar.scherzer@univie.ac.at, Bernd Hofmann hofmannb@mathematik.tu-chemnitz.de, Zuhair Nashed zuhair.nashed@ucf.edu. Neural networks functions are supposed to be able to encode the desired solution of an inverse problem very efficiently. In this paper, we consider the problem of solving linear inverse problems with neural network coders. First we establish some correspondences of this formulation with existing concepts in regularization theory, in particular with state space regularization, operator decomposition and iterative regularization methods.

arxiv-2403-16785.title: Approximating maps into manifolds with lower curvature bounds
arxiv-2403-16785.creator: Simon Jacobsson, Raf Vandebril, Joeri van der Veken, Nick Vannieuwenhoven
arxiv-2403-16785.description: Abstract Many interesting functions arising in applications map into Riemannian manifolds. We present an algorithm, using the manifold exponential and logarithm, for approximating such functions. Our approach extends approximation techniques for functions into linear spaces in such a way that we can upper bound the forward error in terms of a lower bound on the manifold’s sectional curvature.

arxiv-2406-08776.title: Learning joint and individual structure in network data with covariates
arxiv-2406-08776.creator: Carson James, Dongbang Yuan, Irina Gaynanova, Jesús Arroyo
arxiv-2406-08776.description: Abstract Datasets consisting of a network and covariates associated with its vertices have become ubiquitous. One problem pertaining to this type of data is to identify information unique to the network, information unique to the vertex covariates and information that is shared between the network and the vertex covariates.

arxiv-2408-13778.title: A New Active Set Scheme for Quadratic Programing
arxiv-2408-13778.creator: \firstname Negin \lastname Bagherpour, \firstname Nima \lastname Minayi, \firstname AmirHossein \lastname Shanaghi
arxiv-2408-13778.description: Abstract We are faced with convex quadratic programing in many contexts related to control theory, economy and robotics. In this paper, we introduce a new active set algorithm for solving such problems and analyze its possible advantages. The novelty of the proposed scheme is in the way of solving the KKT system based on matrix properties.

pmc-10533362.description: In this issue of JEM, Çakan et al. explore a CXCL4-mediated mechanism by which TLRs cause autoimmunity in human B cells, breaching bone marrow tolerance. B cells can produce antibodies against almost any antigen. pmc-10750745.description: Background and Aim:Studies on ticks of public health concern in equine husbandry are scarce in the Northeastern region of Brazil. This study aimed to investigate the presence of ticks on horses in the State of Alagoas, which is classified as a silent area for human rickettsiosis.

pmc-11475762.title: CTPAD: an interactive web application for comprehensive transcriptomic profiling in allergic diseases
pmc-11475762.creator: Suizi Zhou, Wanqiao Huang, Yitong Liu, Peng Luo, Anqi Lin, Hong Yang, Qianhui Qiu
pmc-11475762.description: BackgroundAllergic diseases are systemic chronic inflammatory diseases associated with multiorgan damage and complex pathogenesis. Several studies have revealed the association of gene expression abnormalities with the development of allergic diseases, but the biomedical field still lacks a public platform for comprehensive analysis and visualization of transcriptomic data of allergic diseases.

pmc-11677142.title: Isolation and Characterization of Bioactive Compounds from Saccharomonospora sp. CMS18 and Their Antifungal Properties

pmc-11677142.description: In this study, metagenomic analysis was employed to investigate the bacterial communities in the Muan tidal mudflat of the Republic of Korea. We used metagenomic analysis to identify the microbial community in tidal soil dominated by Proteobacteria. From this environment, the bacterial strain, Saccharomonospora sp. CMS18, was isolated and yielded two previously unknown compounds, penipaline D (3) and N-acetyl-dimethylallyltryptophan (4).

pmc-12637066.title: Preparation and evaluation of an injectable HAp/Col I composite for promoting tendon-to-bone healing in ACL reconstruction☆
pmc-12637066.creator: Zhanhong Liu, Qingsong Jiang, Liren Wang, Zhiru Chen, Yang Xu, Xiangdong Zhu, Jinzhong Zhao, Yong Wang, Hai Lin, Xingdong Zhang
pmc-12637066.description: Tendon-to-bone healing is considered as a critical determinant influencing the quality of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction. The establishment of a microenvironment conducive to tendon-bone healing remains an urgent challenge for rapidly restoring the structural integrity and functional capacity of damaged tissue. In this study, an injectable hydroxyapatite/collagen type I (HAp/Col I) composite was developed and optimized.

pmc-13135514.title: A polymer of calcium aluminate and water glass as cement substitute
pmc-13135514.creator: Bernd Spangenberg, Jan D Epping
pmc-13135514.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Calcium aluminate cement (CAC) is a suitable source of tetrahedral aluminum, which reacts with tetrahedral silicon from water glass (aqueous sodium or potassium silicate solution) in an exothermic reaction, forming inorganic polymer structures that are stable at high temperatures. All tetrahedrally configurated aluminum atoms of the various calcium aluminates tested, react with tetrahedral silicon groups to form –O–Si–O–Al–O– chains with an average Si/Al ratio near of 1. Octahedrally configurated aluminum, as in γ-Al2O3, does not react at room temperature.

pmc-13324860.title: SPOP-mediated K27-linked non-degradative ubiquitination of KCNN3 suppressing HCC progression via the CTCF-SATB1 axis
pmc-13324860.creator: Ziqing Zhan, Yidong Ge, Jiaxin Shi, Hongze Liang, Yuxuan Li, Jiabei Jin, Gun Chen, Fengguang Zhai, Lili Kong, Yan Lin, Siyuan Wang, Litao Chen, Linlin Liu, Kuihao Chen, Pengrong Lou, Meng Ye, Xiaofeng Jin
pmc-13324860.description: The metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cells remains a major obstacle to achieving favorable clinical outcomes, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms are still not fully understood. The dysregulation of ion channels is related to epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) phenotype-related pathways, especially the aberrant function of K+ ion channels in HCC.

pmc-13363616.title: Advances in Materials for Strontium–Yttrium Separation: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-13363616.creator: Mali Xu, Zhimin Wang, Tong Zhang, Siqi Ma, Shengyang Zhao, Yonggang Zhao, Yan Chen
pmc-13363616.description: Yttrium-90 (90Y) is a pivotal pure beta-emitting radionuclide extensively employed in the targeted therapy of malignant tumors, such as hepatocellular carcinoma and lymphoma. The 90Sr-90Y generator system represents the most effective method for producing no-carrier-added (NCA) 90Y to meet escalating clinical demands.

pmc-13415843.creator: Raffaella Comitato, Federica Intorre, Eugenia Venneria
pmc-13415843.description: the most informative recent work shares a feature that is easy to overlook: the molecules that matter rarely act alone or on a single target. pmc-13465857.title: Natural hazards and population impact in Sri Lanka, 2010–2025
pmc-13465857.creator: Dewarahandhi Kavishka Madushan De Silva, Sudath Shirly Pathmasiri Warnakulasuriya, Samath D. Dharmaratne
pmc-13465857.description: BackgroundSri Lanka is highly vulnerable to climate-sensitive natural hazards, yet long-term national evidence on disaster patterns and human impacts remains fragmented. Robust synthesis of historical disaster data is essential to inform prevention, preparedness, and public health resilience. This study aimed to characterize temporal trends, dominant hazard types, and population-level impacts of natural hazards in Sri Lanka from 2010 to 2025.
